get.summary: Read the feature document this process serves
get.description: The feature names this process serves, ascending and without repetition. The set is decided by the assembly at start and is the same for every caller; it is not filtered by permission or tenant. Its content may differ between callers and tenants (a tenant-level narrowing is a future addition), so a response must not be cached across sessions.

200.description: The feature document. Its content may differ per caller and tenant, and must not be cached across sessions.

Cache-Control.description: Always no-store: the document must not be cached across sessions.

features.description: The feature names this process serves, ascending and without repetition. Each name answers whether a frontend surface the caller's build carries is served here; the response carries no configuration value, method descriptor or rendering description.
